from pathlib import Path
import struct
for fn in ['simple-bw-gimp-2.8.10.xcf','simple-rgb-gimp-2.8.10.xcf']:
 data=Path('autotests/read/xcf/'+fn).read_bytes()
 print('\n',fn,len(data))
 off=0
 print(data[:14], off); off=14
 print('wh type', struct.unpack('>III',data[off:off+12])); off+=12
 # props
 while True:
  typ,size=struct.unpack('>II',data[off:off+8]); off+=8
  print('prop',typ,size,'at',off-8, data[off:off+min(size,16)].hex())
  if typ==0: break
  if typ==1:
   n=struct.unpack('>I',data[off:off+4])[0]; print(' ncolors',n)
  off+=size
 print('after props',off)
 offs=[]
 while True:
  val=struct.unpack('>I',data[off:off+4])[0]; off+=4; print('layeroff',val)
  if val==0: break
  offs.append(val)
 print('channel start',off)
 for lo in offs:
  o=lo
  w,h,t=struct.unpack('>III',data[o:o+12]); o+=12
  # read QString? QDataStream >> char* = uint len + bytes? inspect
  l=struct.unpack('>I',data[o:o+4])[0]; o+=4
  name=data[o:o+l]; o+=l
  print(' layer',lo,'wh type name',w,h,t,l,name)
  while True:
   typ,size=struct.unpack('>II',data[o:o+8]); o+=8
   print('  lprop',typ,size,'at',o-8,data[o:o+size].hex())
   if typ==0: break
   o+=size
  hier,mask=struct.unpack('>II',data[o:o+8]); o+=8
  print('  hier mask',hier,mask,'after',o)
  ho=hier
  print('  hierdata', struct.unpack('>IIII',data[ho:ho+16])); ho+=16
  lev_offsets=[]
  while True:
   v=struct.unpack('>I',data[ho:ho+4])[0]; ho+=4; print('   levptr',v)
   if v==0: break
   lev_offsets.append(v)
  for le in lev_offsets:
   w,h,to=struct.unpack('>III',data[le:le+12]); print('   level',le,w,h,to,'nextoff',struct.unpack('>I',data[le+12:le+16])[0])
